description: This file implements the SocketPort class and related functions for managing network sockets, including creation, configuration, connection handling, data transmission, and multicast group management, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Initializes Windows Sockets API (Winsock) and retrieves function pointers for extended socket functions.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, with platform-specific handling for IPv4 and IPv6, including extraction of interface index information.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on NodeId and interface parameters, with platform-specific code for Unix domain sockets and network sockets.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for a socket to become open within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for ongoing write operations to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for a socket to close within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns the current event flags for the socket, indicating readiness or errors.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events based on flags, triggering read, write, accept, or close operations.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into the receive buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from the send buffer to the socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens and initializes the socket connection.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a write slot and resource monitor break to handle pending writes.
